_doc: The ADVENTURE-eval ruler (A-series A-T). This file is the SOLE content that fences what an adventure aggregate score MEANS: the per-dimension weakest-link thresholds + the named next-lever each weakest dimension routes to. Hashed by scoring_config_version.adventure_config_version() into an av_ family (its OWN hash namespace, per HV1's rule) — NEVER folded into SCORING_CONFIG_FILES, which would silently re-version the sc_/lc_ engine-duo rulers. Edit this and every FUTURE adventure aggregate re-versions on its own axis; the engine-duo + artifact trends stay byte-identical.

completion.lever: arc-completion: tighten the DM arc addendum, verify the giver->crypt->boss->return seam is unblocked, or raise the beat budget

pace.lever: pace: the arc drags to completion; sharpen the per-beat objective nudges that push toward the crypt and the boss

stuck.lever: stuck: dead beats / stage-gap stalls; investigate the blocked stage (a travel or combat seam the party could not cross)

engagement.lever: engagement: authored systems left inert; wire the dead system(s) into the arc so the loop exercises them

story.lever: story-craft: the Tolkien narration lens is weakest; raise the DM's scene-craft bar

mechanics.lever: mechanics: the 5e-fidelity / mechanical tool-usage lens is weakest; tighten DM tool discipline

behavioral.lever: behavioral: the deterministic gate is RED on runs; fix the structural break before chasing quality
